title: Evaluation of Information Displays-A Paper, Computer and Simulator Based Study
brief_summary: Our objective is to develop intuitive, meaningful and ergonomically efficient informative displays specific to the user's domain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* projected end users of the domain specific visualizations.
* experts and novice users of the domain specific information.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects having been exposed to a particular visualization prior to testing.
study_population: projected end users of the domain specific visualizations. experts and novice users of the domain specific information.
